text_block_list.text:
Early in the morning, while taking a 
leisurely stroll—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Oh, um~. Are you training too, Cafe-san?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I see, so you intend to conquer the 
freshly awakened sun, do you?! 
Magnificent...! It seems you too possess 
the caliber of a leading star!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...I'm not quite sure... what you mean... 
...I am not quite on your level... 
however...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! But of course I know that!! Yet 
both you and Doto will undoubtedly become 
splendid presences that allow me to shine 
even brighter!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Which means! You both are leading-class 
talents yourselves! Bathe in my brilliance 
and shine beautifully! Now, let us run 
together into the morning sunrise!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah, um... Opera O-san... Cafe-san has 
already started running...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oops, her running style is just like a 
cat's. Before you know it, she glides 
gracefully away.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. And... how should I put it, 
there's no hesitation at all, almost 
like... she's desperately chasing after 
"something"...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
C-Could it be that the rumored invisible 
"friend" really is there...?!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! If she is a cat's friend, then she 
too must be a cat! Even if unseen, they 
can still compose the melody of footsteps 
together!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
We cannot afford to lose either... Come, 
Doto! Toward the light-filled horizon!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes~!

Full of energy from so early in the 
morning. I called out words of 
encouragement to their receding backs, 
watching them go.

—That evening. Just as I finished work and 
was about to head home, I spotted 
Manhattan Cafe taking a break.

When I told her I saw her with TM Opera O 
and Meisho Doto this morning—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Those two have... a nice... 
relationship... don't they...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Inspiring one another... and growing 
together... Unlike me... and my 
"friend"...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I only... receive... To my "friend"... or 
to anyone else... I have nothing... that I 
can give...

To be honest, I don't really understand 
her "friend," but having something to 
strive for, becoming someone's goal— just 
that alone surely offers something to 
others.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Even if I pass you... up ahead... there is 
still my "friend's" back, so...

text_block_list.name: Light-haired Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
...I see. Still, somehow... it's 
frustrating.

That frustration she felt was likely the 
very inspiration given to her by Manhattan 
Cafe.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Phew... It's about time... I head back... 
to the track...
choice_data_list: Are you going to run more?
Are you still going to run?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Yes... Just... a little more...

...She looks exhausted. As expected, I 
should stop her here.
choice_data_list:
Why not rest early and run again tomorrow 
morning?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
............ ...I suppose... you're 
right...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Is there... anyone... ...you want to catch 
up to...?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Is that so. Facing each other, growing 
together... I'm... just a little 
jealous...

Having said that, Manhattan Cafe gave a 
small smile and vanished into the darkness 
of the night.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Morning... or night... I will run... ...As 
long as that back... running ahead of 
me... remains in sight...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
So that I can catch up... and proudly 
tell... my "friend"... that we are 
rivals...

Bowing lightly, Manhattan Cafe returned to 
the track. Looking toward the spot where 
she murmured "Sorry to keep you waiting," 
there was nobody to be seen...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...I'm not... overdoing it...

Despite her words, her legs appeared to be 
trembling slightly.
choice_data_list: You have to stay in top shape.

text_block_list.text:
Just like before, someone might come and 
ask "Please run with me." If you can't run 
properly when that happens—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...That wouldn't... trouble me at all... 
All I want... is to catch up... to my 
"friend"...

Saying so, Manhattan Cafe headed back onto 
the track.

In that empty space where we could see 
nothing, she was single-mindedly fixated 
upon the back of the one she admired.
